name: Vegetable Idli Fry
category: Healthy Indian Snacks and Street Food
ingredients: 6 small idlis (about 300 g), cut into cubes
½ tsp each mustard seeds and cumin seeds
1 tsp sambar powder or ½ tsp chilli powder
steps: Heat the oil in a wide pan and crackle the mustard and cumin. Add the curry leaves.
Add the onion and capsicum and cook for 4 minutes.
Add the spices, chickpeas and idli cubes.
Toss on medium-high heat for 5 minutes until the idli edges are lightly crisp.
Finish with lemon juice and coriander.
note: A good way to use leftover idli; chickpeas add the protein idli lacks.
